title: One shell starts a program sixty times in a burst
threat_model: An attacker's script starts many short programs in a burst, for example to scan or to run a command over a list.
notes: One bash runs /bin/true COUNT times in a loop with no pause. COUNT is set at the top of action.sh, and a unit test requires it to be at least twice SPAWN_THRESHOLD. The children are started by the action's own bash, a process the loader saw start.
